cards.text: Then a man is brought to Jesus, and friend, this man has a LOT going on. He's demon-possessed, he's blind AND he's mute.

cards.question: A demon-possessed man who can't see or speak is standing in front of Jesus. What happens?

answers.text: Jesus heals him so he can speak and see
Jesus sends him to the temple priests
Jesus sends him to wash in a pool

cards.text: The crowds see the whole thing, and they are ASTOUNDED. People start asking a big question about who Jesus is.

cards.question: The crowds who saw Jesus heal the man are astounded. What do they start asking about Jesus?

answers.text: If He could be the Son of David
If He could be Elijah come back
If He could be John the Baptist

cards.text: But the Pharisees, a group of strict Jewish religious leaders, hear what the crowds are saying. And they've got a VERY different explanation.

cards.question: The Pharisees say Jesus drives out demons by the power of God.

cards.text: They say, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.” Jesus knows their thoughts, and He answers with a picture: a kingdom divided against itself.

cards.question: Jesus answers the Pharisees with a picture of a kingdom divided against itself. What does He say happens to it?

cards.text: Same goes for every city or household divided against itself: it will not stand. Then Jesus asks what happens if Satan drives out Satan.

cards.question: Jesus says if Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. What's the problem with that for Satan?

cards.text: Then Jesus flips it: if He drives out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do the Pharisees' own sons drive them out? Friend, that's the kind of question where everybody suddenly finds their shoes VERY interesting.

cards.question: Jesus tells the Pharisees that their own sons, who drive out demons too, will be their ___.

cards.text: Option one? Doesn't hold up. Doesn't hold UP. So here comes option two: what if Jesus is driving out demons by the Spirit of God?

cards.question: Jesus says that if He drives out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon them.

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: a strong man's house, and someone who wants to carry off everything inside. Friend, that strong man is NOT going to just hold the door open.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture, to plunder a strong man's house, you first have to ___ the strong man.

cards.text: Then Jesus makes it plain. There's no sitting on the fence with this one, and friend, I'm a stamper on a gold base. I couldn't get UP on a fence if I tried.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever is not with Him is ___ Him, and whoever does not gather with Him ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “Therefore I tell you,” and friend, when you hear that, you put your phone DOWN. He says every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, except one.

cards.question: Jesus says every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, except one. Which blasphemy will not be forgiven?
Jesus says whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will not be forgiven.

cards.text: Jesus says speaking against the Holy Spirit won't be forgiven, “either in this age or in the one to come.” Friend, I've had some long waits in my life, but there's no waiting this one out.

Then Jesus switches to trees. Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, make it bad and its fruit will be bad. Friend, I spent years in a drawer and I've never touched a tree, but even I can follow this one.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture of the good tree and the bad tree, how is a tree known?

answers.text: By the roots it puts down

cards.text: Then Jesus says to the Pharisees, “You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good?” Friend, that is NOT a pep talk.

cards.question: Jesus tells the Pharisees the words a mouth speaks come out of the overflow of something. What is it?

cards.text: Then Jesus says the good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure. Same as my cookie boxes, friend: you only get out what got packed in.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture, the evil man brings good things out of his evil store of treasure.

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about the day of judgment and the words people speak, even the ones that slip out without a thought. Friend, I talk a LOT, so I am leaning ALL the way in on this one.

cards.question: Jesus says men will give an account on the day of judgment for every ___ word they have spoken.
Jesus finishes: by your words you will be ___, and by your words you will be condemned.
